title: git kura open --dry-run — envelope data
description: Command-specific schema for the data payload of `git kura open --dry-run --json`, nested under the common envelope's data field. It describes the worktree that open would create; it is never created by a dry run, so exists and dirty are always false.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this data payload.

key.description: The key passed to the command.

branch.description: Git branch that open would create for the key.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the worktree that open would create.

repositoryRoot.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

baseBranch.description: Branch the worktree would be created from.

exists.description: Always false: a dry run never creates the worktree.

dirty.description: Always false: a dry run never creates the worktree.
